FR-001.title: The wireframe set MUST cover the screens and states listed in Story 1 at about 1440, 1000 and 400 pixels wide.

FR-002.title: The Diff and panel wireframes MUST annotate keyboard path and focus order, including focus on panel open and close.

FR-003.title: Stage 2 MUST NOT start until the product owner has approved the wireframes.

FR-004.title: The wireframes MUST label every capability that did not exist before as .

FR-005.title: Diff rows MUST distinguish added, removed and unchanged lines by a `+`/`−` mark and a background, in both themes.

FR-006.title: Diff range selection MUST work by keyboard: Enter or Space sets the anchor, Shift with an arrow extends, Escape clears, and each line control shows a visible focus indicator.

FR-007.title: A selection change MUST update a visible scope bar and be announced to screen readers.

FR-008.title: Selected diff rows MUST show a selection bar as well as a colour change.

FR-009.title: Every claim and completeness badge MUST show its text label, an icon, and a colour meeting AA contrast in both themes.

FR-010.title: Following a code citation MUST highlight the full cited range, from its first to its last line.

FR-011.title: The code view MUST preserve whitespace and scroll long lines inside the code region.

FR-012.title: The Ask form MUST give the question box a visible label, group Category and Answer-for choices with group names, link errors to their fields, and announce a submit failure immediately.

FR-013.title: The Ask button MUST show why it is unavailable whenever it is disabled.

FR-014.title: Every page MUST have an app header with a skip-to-content link, the product name linking Home, repository identity, connection state, and a settings menu holding Setup and Sign-in.

FR-015.title: Every review-session page MUST show the review header, review navigation and context strip described in Story 5.

FR-016.title: The context strip and all other copy MUST NOT state or imply that a PR is ready, safe or approved to merge.

FR-017.title: The question draft, Category, Answer-for choice, selected scope and per-page scroll position MUST survive navigation within the same session.

FR-018.title: Answer-for MUST default to Technical and keep the reviewer's choice for that session.

FR-019.title: At 1200 pixels and wider, Ask and Evidence MUST open as side panels; between 900 and 1199 pixels they MUST overlay the page; below 900 pixels they MUST open the existing full-page routes.

FR-020.title: Opening a panel MUST move focus to its heading; closing it (button or Escape) MUST return focus to the control that opened it.

FR-021.title: The Evidence panel MUST show the cited source with its full range highlighted and an "Open full page" link to the existing route.

FR-022.title: Overview MUST offer "Ask about this PR"; Files MUST offer "Ask about selection" when a range is selected.

FR-023.title: Every existing route MUST keep working as a deep link with the same content.

FR-024.title: At 1200 pixels and wider, the file list MUST sit in a collapsible left region; between 900 and 1199 pixels it MUST be a drawer.

FR-025.title: Overview MUST order PR summary, context completeness, changed files, then referenced PRs, with per-file summaries disclosed on request.

FR-026.title: The file list MUST offer a text filter over its files.

FR-027.title: Overview MUST reserve an empty "Review focus" region and MUST NOT show risk, coverage, readiness or role content in it.

FR-028.title: Every region that loads data MUST distinguish loading, empty, failed, unknown and stale, and offer Retry when failed.

FR-029.title: Failures that are currently hidden (session list, AI provider check, suggested questions) MUST be shown as failed states.

FR-030.title: A dropped live-update stream MUST show the "Live updates paused — Reconnect" banner on session pages, and Reconnect MUST restore updates.

FR-031.title: Streaming answer text and scope changes MUST be announced politely to screen readers, throttled so speech does not flood.

FR-032.title: Close and Delete MUST sit in a secondary session-actions menu.

FR-033.title: Delete MUST open a confirmation dialog stating what is lost, with focus on Cancel, Escape cancelling, and a danger-styled confirm.

FR-034.title: Setup MUST show only the fields for the chosen source-control platform and chosen tracker, using the platforms registered at implementation time.

FR-035.title: Setup MUST show limits in human units inside a collapsed "Advanced limits" section with defaults visible.

FR-036.title: Setup MUST show each server validation error at its field and in a summary at the top.

FR-037.title: After a successful save, Setup MUST show a connection checklist with each check's status and next step.

FR-038.title: Sign-in MUST explain why it is needed and that access is read-only, and MUST return the reviewer to the originating page after success.

FR-039.title: Home MUST list sessions before open PRs, give each row "Start review" or "Resume review", show empty and failed states, busy only the row being started, and offer a filter over loaded items.

FR-040.title: Every page MUST meet WCAG 2.2 AA, with landmarks, exactly one top-level heading, labelled controls, no meaning carried by colour alone, reduced motion respected and targets at least 24 by 24 pixels.

FR-041.title: Every page MUST work in light and dark themes and at 400, 1000 and 1440 pixels wide without page-level horizontal scrolling.

FR-042.title: All PR, issue, code and AI text MUST still be shown as plain text; the redesign MUST NOT introduce any path that renders it as markup.

FR-043.title: The interface MUST NOT offer any action that writes to the repository or to any platform.

FR-044.title: Evidence/Inference labels, unresolved-reference reasons, skipped-file reasons and the older-head marker MUST stay visible wherever they appear today.

FR-045.title: Every existing feature listed in guide §3 "Strengths to preserve" MUST remain available.

FR-046.title: Existing test identifiers MUST stay stable, or each change MUST be made deliberately with the affected tests updated in the same change.

FR-047.title: New automated tests MUST cover range highlighting, keyboard selection, badge attributes, state preserved across navigation, and cancelling Delete.

FR-048.title: Setup MUST take one base folder, one source-control platform (with a base address when declared) and one issue tracker, replacing the single repository and clone path.

FR-049.title: The workbench MUST find every git repository under the base folder at any depth, without changing any, without following symbolic links, and without looking inside its own data folder.

FR-050.title: Each found repository MUST be matched to the chosen platform by its remotes; one with no matching remote MUST be listed as skipped with the reason.

FR-051.title: The same platform repository in several folders MUST appear once, using the clone nearest the base folder (ties alphabetical), naming the folder used and listing the others as duplicates.

FR-052.title: Home MUST be a dashboard of open PRs across all matched repositories, each row with repository, number, title, author, branches, updated time and Start or Resume review, newest first.

FR-053.title: The dashboard MUST filter by repository and by text, over loaded items.

FR-054.title: A repository whose PRs fail to load MUST show its own failed state with Retry while every other repository's PRs still show.

FR-055.title: Every review page MUST show the PR's repository and offer Back to dashboard, which restores the dashboard's filters and scroll position.

FR-056.title: Setup MUST show the discovery result (matched, skipped with reasons, duplicates) and Rescan; discovery MUST run on save, on Rescan and at start-up.

FR-057.title: A session whose repository is no longer under the base folder MUST stay readable, with Refresh and Ask unavailable and the reason shown.

FR-058.title: The issue tracker settings MUST apply to every repository; a tracker reading issues from the repository itself MUST use each PR's own repository.

decisions.decision: Playwright library + @axe-core/playwright as devDependencies, browser tests in test/ui/*.ui.ts under node:test via npm run test:ui
decisions.why: FR-047, SC-001 and SC-003 need a real layout engine; one test runner; no runtime dependency (Q.1)

decisions.decision: UI logic in plain .ts modules under src/ui/state/ so node --test can import them
decisions.why: Node strips types but does not compile JSX
decisions.rejected: testing all logic through the browser

decisions.decision: View state in sessionStorage, one allowlisted versioned key per session plus one for the dashboard
decisions.why: Matches the clarification exactly: per tab, survives reload, never sent, no credentials (X.7)
decisions.rejected: localStorage (outlives tab) and URL state (leaks drafts into history)

decisions.decision: Remove main key={hash}; ReviewShell keyed by session id owns detail, one event stream and the live region
decisions.why: Stops the remount that loses state and the header flicker; POST /open runs once per session

decisions.decision: Panel state lives in view state, not the URL; three bands at 1200 and 900 pixels; narrow uses existing routes
decisions.why: Deep links stay the existing routes (FR-023)
decisions.rejected: panel in the hash, which makes each open a navigation

decisions.decision: Discovery walks with fs.opendir, no symlinks, reads remotes via the Repository manager, matches by a new adapter method repositoryForRemote
decisions.why: Keeps git access in one place (IX.2) and platform path rules inside adapters (VIII.2)
decisions.rejected: parsing .git/config by hand, or deriving the match in core

decisions.decision: GET /api/pulls returns one PullGroup per repository with its own loaded or failed status; ?repository= retries one
decisions.why: Per-repository failure without failing the dashboard (V.4, FR-054)
decisions.rejected: browser fan-out of one request per repository

decisions.decision: Session environment is built per session repository; a missing clone gives repositoryAvailable false and 409 repository_unavailable
decisions.why: The store already keys sessions by repository; the folder is looked up at use so it can move

decisions.decision: Old repository-shaped config loads as not configured, with no migration
decisions.why: Guessing a base folder from a clone path could scan a home directory; the product is unreleased

decisions.decision: Refresh the existing plan against the current spec instead of regenerating it
decisions.why: Plan, spec and tasks were edited together after tasks closed; check_plan passes and every verbatim constraint is already in contracts
decisions.rejected: Full regeneration, which would make the 87-task list stale

decisions.why: Keeps phases and single-file ownership intact; closes untested FR-028 states, SC-005 test:gitlab, FR-006/011/014/017/024/031/054 and two edge cases
decisions.rejected: New test tasks, which would add files and owners late

decisions.decision: Panel host owns openAsk/openEvidence; wide opens panels beside the page, medium overlays, narrow navigates
decisions.why: Keeps the diff and cursor in place while asking
decisions.rejected: Always navigating to the Ask page

decisions.decision: Diff line selection is by the line-number button only, not the whole row

approach: Fix the P0 diff, badge, range and Ask-form defects in src/ui first, then remove the per-hash remount so a session-keyed ReviewShell owns the session, one stream and sessionStorage view state, with Ask and Evidence as width-dependent panels over the existing routes.
